Specification: This module is a regression test for Apalache's Gen operator behavior when the same expression is passed multiple times. It models a two-variable state with integer-typed variables a and b, and defines two alternative initial-state predicates intended to ensure that generated values are distinct even when Gen is called with identical arguments. The specification contains only initialization predicates and a stuttering Next action, with no temporal properties beyond the action definition and no explicit fault model.
